answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, underpinned by verifiable delay functions and a trusted beacon. The ridge of our construction lies in proving computational hardness of identity spoofing, achieved through information-theoretic unforgeability. Assuming a comet of honest agents, our scheme ensures that an adversary cannot clone identities, as the sequential delay function governing reputation updates is infeasible to invert, thereby guaranteeing cryptographic finality and Byzantine fault tolerance.
